verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a compliance SaaS platform that holds customer evidence, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers retention settings, deletion workflows, or data lifecycle controls, whether for workspace data or for AI/MCP interactions. The GDPR items describe helping customers achieve their own compliance, not controlling data held in Thoropass, and the AI Helpbot transparency item only describes answering questions from approved content.
